balls.text: dug into the track outside off and Russell cannot make the most of it. Swings at it wildly and only swats away a few flies. He also ventures out of his crease, trying to pinch a bye and is caught unawares as Klaasen hits the stumps at the batter's end. Russell dismissed, and KKR end with 200!
full and wide outside off. Rinku reaches out for it and clinks it towards sweeper cover. Just a single

slower bumper outside off and this seems to balloon over the batter's head. Rinku nearly swings himself off his feet and when he settles down, he sees the square leg umpire's arms outstretched. But now SRH will review because, well, why not. Seems to be above the batter's head, despite Rinku jumping up and the wide call stays!
banged into the track outside off. Russell tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards extra cover

high into the night sky, and taken on the fence! That almost touched the moon and came back! Slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Venkatesh, after shimmying his socks off, stands still in his normal stance and gets under it. Gets under it too much in the end, though, and does not get the adequate distance. Aniket settles himself at long on and does the rest!

that is dreadful bowling, but KKR will not mind one bit! Thigh-high full toss kissing the wide line, with short third up. That is asking for trouble and Venkatesh, even though he does not middle it, slashes it over that fielder for four. KKR have also reviewed it, arguing it should be a No ball. Might be a little optimistic but no harm in trying, eh? Venkatesh's waist is measured at 1.13m and the ball is passing the popping crease at 1.01m. Fair delivery, but KKR still get four!
smashed over long on first ball! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off and Venkatesh reads it like the morning newspaper. Sets himself up and slams it over the fence!
length ball that follows Venkatesh a mile outside leg. He misses his swing and the ball bobbles off the pads behind square

low full toss on the stumps. Venkatesh drills it back towards the bowler, who gets his boot in the way. The ball then trickles towards long on, who hits the stumps at the bowler's end, and KKR get a run off the deflection, which means Venkatesh brings up a 25-ball fifty!

oh my - Venkatesh is like a house on fire now! Full and wide, tries to bluff the batter, who backs away early. Venkatesh, though, uses his long reach to perfection. Gets bat on it and also scythes it over backward point!

everything is travelling to the fence now! This seems like a good yorker, tailing into the pads but such is KKR's momentum that Venkatesh, somehow, manages to squeeze this out behind square. Onto the practice pitches and that races away!
more catching practice for the crowd! Another slower bumper and this sits up on off stump. Venkatesh picks it up and pummels it over deep square leg!

innovation at its best! Cutter bowled into the track on middle and off. Venkatesh walks across, plays four strokes in his mind and then eventually makes contact with his fifth attempt, which is a ramp over the keeper's head!
watch that white ball fly into the Kolkata night sky! Right in the slot outside off and that is a buffet ball. Rinku helps himself, steps into the shot and launches it a mile over long on!
back of a length outside off. Venkatesh has a massive heave at it and drags it towards deep mid wicket
four more! Venkatesh is coming to the party too now! Off-pace short ball on middle and leg. Venkatesh opens up his stance and slugs it to deep mid wicket's left!
just past the fielder, and that hurtles into the fence! Slow, short, wide and it gets the treatment it deserves. Venkatesh stands tall and slaps it just to extra cover's left!
off-pace and into the track on off. Rinku hacks it towards deep mid wicket and both batters are content with a single
full toss wide outside off. Venkatesh throws his hands at it and slashes it towards sweeper cover. Just a single
short ball on middle and leg to finish off. Venkatesh swipes it on the bounce to deep backward square leg and keeps strike
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Rinku taps it towards backward point and ambles across to the other end
shot - the best of the lot so far! Right in the slot outside off. Rinku climbs into the drive and crrrrrrrunnnnnnchhhheessssss it between mid off and extra cover!

and that is more scratchy fielding on the fence! Slower full toss wide outside off. Rinku opens his bat face and glides it towards deep backward point. Aniket makes an absolute meal of it, and Rinku gets some bonus runs!
that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Banged into the track outside off and this just sits up. Rinku gets on top of the bounce and bludgeons it to deep mid wicket's right!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Venkatesh is deceived by the lack of pace initially and adjusts to dab it towards deep backward point
Rinku lands his first punch now! Gentle and juicy full toss outside off. Rinku throws his hands at it and crashes it over extra cover for four!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Venkatesh backs away and squeezes it out to long off
short, wide and punished! Shami makes the dual mistake of bowling too short and offering plenty of width. Venkatesh camps on it and upper-cuts it over short third!
zipped in fuller on middle and off. Venkatesh flicks it enough to long on's left and careens back for two
slower delivery banged into the track outside off. Venkatesh shimmies around before settling in his normal stance. Swipes at it and only grabs a handful of fresh air
fullish just outside off. Rinku presses half forward and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slower ball on a full length outside off. Venkatesh drills it down the ground but cannot beat the fielder in the ring at mid off

well, scratch that, because KKR have a boundary now, and they have a maximum to boot! Attempted bumper but the line is all wrong. Down leg and that allows Venkatesh to just help it away over fine leg!
dug into the track on off. Rinku gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
hard length, pushed across the batter outside off. Rinku advances and then has an ungainly hack at it. Chops it back to the bowler
slower ball on a shortish length on leg stump. Rinku swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. A slight misfield by Harshal on the fence and Rinku saunters back for two
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rinku jams down on it and digs it out towards extra cover
cutter on a back of a length, slanting into off stump. Rinku swipes at it incredibly early and the ball rolls off the toe-end towards deep third
slower delivery dug in short on leg stump. Venkatesh waits for it and heaves it towards deep mid wicket. Still has not come to grips with the pace of this surface
off-pace again and into the track again, outside off. Venkatesh has a swish at it but is too early into the stroke to make contact
back of a length on middle and off. No real room to work with and Rinku prods it into the cover point region for a single
slower bumper that goes a bit awry and slides down leg. Left alone by Rinku and called a wide
cutter on a back of a length just outside off. Rinku hops up onto his toes and drops it into the off side with soft hands
angled in on a hard length on the stumps. Venkatesh stabs it towards long on off the back foot
fired in full outside off. Driven down the ground to long off and Venkatesh retains strike
back of a length outside off. Rinku goes back and taps it towards sweeper cover

has Harshal grabbed that? Oh, that would be a world-class catch if he has! Dangles the carrot on a length outside off and Raghuvanshi bites. He looks to go inside-out but slices across it too much. Arrows it towards deep backward point, where Harshal runs in off the fence, slides forward and then swoops it up inches off the turf. Exceptional, exceptional fielding, and SRH have gotten rid of the set batter!
follows the batter outside leg with a length ball. Cramped for room, Raghuvanshi prods it back towards the bowler
dragged down just outside off. Venkatesh goes back and hacks it towards long on
full outside off. Raghuvanshi eases it down the ground and brings up his half-century - off just 30 balls, and with his side under all sorts of pressure!
off-pace and into the track just outside off. Venkatesh advances and jabs it straight to extra cover
slower bumper on middle and off. Raghuvanshi lets the ball arrive before tugging it to mid wicket's right

placed to absolute perfection! Slower ball that ends up as a half-volley on off. Raghuvanshi plays the check drive and finds the gap between extra cover and mid off. It was in the air but well wide of both fielders!
back of a length just outside off. Venkatesh tips it to extra cover and canters across to the other end
slanted across full outside off. Venkatesh, without any real footwork, wafts at it and is beaten for pace more than anything else

dropped by Reddy - oh dear! Shortish outside off and this sits up to be hit. Raghuvanshi tries to hack it over cow corner but toe-ends it badly. Reddy runs in off the fence and then puts down a fairly regulation chance. Reddy will be disappointed with that. Tried to take it too low and paid the price. Straight in and straight out

Ansari celebrates, Klaasen celebrates and the finger goes up! Rahane perishes trying to do what Raghuvanshi did earlier in the over! Slower, shorter and hung up outside off. Drops on Rahane late and the ball is much shorter than he thinks it is. Cannot get purchase on the reverse and the ball pops up off the glove, held on easily by Klaasen. A feisty knock by the KKR skipper, and they now have a solid foundation to push for 200!
googly on a length outside off. Raghuvanshi reaches out for it and jabs it towards cover point
this is an even better stroke, and much more audacious! Fired in full on off. Raghuvanshi unfurls the reverse for the second time this over and nails it over backward point!
clean as a whistle! Tossed up into the slot outside off and Ansari gets met. Raghuvanshi steps into the stroke and pumps it over long off!
full again, on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi brings out the reverse and swipes it through backward point. Good work on the fence to keep it to two. Reddy was the fielder
full outside off, denying the batter from getting under it. Raghuvanshi pokes it towards extra cover
banged in short, and deposited into the stands! That ended up being a half-tracker and was just begging to be hit. Rahane obliged and pulverized it over deep mid wicket!
full just outside off. Raghuvanshi presses forward and drives it crisply towards mid off, who sprawls to his left and ensures it is just a single. Aniket the fielder
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rahane waits for this and jabs it towards sweeper cover
in the slot outside off and Rahane misses out. Tries to smash it into the Bay of Bengal and only swats away a few flies
back of a length wide outside off. Rahane shuffles across and looks to play the lap. Makes a mess of it, though, and seems to get pinged on the body
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
short and wide outside off. Raghuvanshi goes back and punches it powerfully towards sweeper cover
very full just outside off. Rahane digs it out towards long on
leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets decent purchase on the cut but cannot get it past backward point
shorter and wider. Rahane waits for it and eases it towards sweeper cover
oh! Fizzed in on a length on middle and leg. Rahane plays the trajectory and hangs back. Stabs at it hurriedly and the ball pops up off the leading edge, landing in front of Cummins at extra cover

through the hands again, and SRH are not covering themselves in glory in the field here! Full toss on the stumps. Raghuvanshi cracks it towards extra cover, who misfields and lets the ball go through. Ansari the guilty party!
slower bumper outside off that takes an eternity to arrive. Raghuvanshi waits and waits for it before swishing at thin air
another slower ball, pitching full outside off. Rahane presses forward and flicks it to long on
angled in full on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi gets forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a full length just outside off. Raghuvanshi pats it back towards the bowler
welcomed with a boundary! Wide half-volley and that is not the greatest of starts. Raghuvanshi reaches out for it, opens his bat face and razes it enough to sweeper cover's left!
short and wide outside off. Rahane has a huge waft at it but the lack of pace means he jams it off the inside edge into Klaasen's pads
back of a length on leg stump. Raghuvanshi gets onto the back foot and punches it towards deep mid wicket
tossed up full on middle and off. Raghuvanshi stretches forward and smothers it
back of a length on middle and off. Rahane goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
sloppy on the fence, and Rahane has his first four! Shortish outside off. Rahane hops back and cuts it towards deep point. Reddy slides and inadvertently kicks it into the fence!
dragged down on off. Rahane opens up his stance and hacks it towards long on for a couple of runs. Raghuvanshi had to hustle but made it in the end, courtesy a dive
Raghuvanshi wants a piece of Simarjeet too! Bumper on middle and leg, and the line allows Raghuvanshi to get inside and hook it with consummate ease over the fine leg fence!
dug into the track again, just outside off. Comes off much slower than he expects and he is very early into the pull. Cops a blow on the ribs for his troubles, but does get a run for his team
hard length just outside off. Raghuvanshi opens his bat face and guides it towards deep backward point
off-pace and into the track just outside off. Rahane drops it into the off side and looks at his partner, who responds and makes the single a very comfortable exercise

Rahane is peppering the leg-side tonight! This is another short ball that does not get up as high as the bowler wants. Up to the waist and Rahane wallops it over deep backward square leg, swiveling to add further oomph to the stroke!
length outside off. Rahane looks to drive on the up but ends up scuffing it towards the bowler, who gathers on his follow-through to his left

flayed away! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi marches down the track and throws the kitchen sink at it. Slashes it behind point and the ball skips off the practice pitches to beat the sweeper on the deep backward point fence!
back of a length just outside off. Rahane gets up on his toes and stabs it enough to mid on's right for a single
Rahane has come to play tonight! Fullish in and around off. Rahane picks the line and the length early, almost gets down on one knee and dumps it over the deep backward square leg fence!
shortish outside off. Rahane hangs back in his crease and tries to force it through the off side. Scuffs it to extra cover instead
back of a length just outside off. Rahane stays back, creates a bit of room for himself by staying leg-side of the ball and punches it to cover point
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and jabs it towards deep backward point
back of a length in the channel. Decks back in considerably and nearly cuts Rahane in half. Off the back thigh and on the bounce to the keeper
oh my days - that is a shot and a half! Marginally short outside off and Rahane climbs into it. He stands up tall and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
dug into the track on middle and off. Raghuvanshi stands up on his toes and pulls it on the bounce to deep backward square leg. On another day, that might have carried
hard length just outside off and this seams back in a touch. Cramps Raghuvanshi on the cut and he chunks it off the inside edge into his body
oopsie! Much fuller outside off. Raghuvanshi clinks his drive towards extra cover, who misfields and allows a couple of runs
back of a length outside off and this zips off the surface. Raghuvanshi gives Cummins the charge and then wafts at it, only to connect with fresh air
shorter outside off. Rahane rises with the bounce and punches it towards cover point. Dot to end the over
length outside off. Rahane gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover. Did not time that as well as the flick earlier in the over
hard length outside off. A bit of nip back in and Raghuvanshi watches the ball all the way, dabbing it towards deep backward point

nicked and gone! KKR lose their second in as many overs, and Shami is on the board as well now! Right up in the blockhole, just outside off. Narine backs away early and then tries to squeeze it out. Gets a thick outside edge and Klaasen gobbles it up to his left comfortably. Narine hangs around, perhaps hoping for some support from his captain, but then trudges off reluctantly. The bat hit the ground and the ball then hit the outside edge. Shami raises his right hand in celebration, and KKR are two down inside three overs!
fullish just outside off. Rahane transfers his weight forward and flicks it neatly to mid on's right. Cummins dives full-stretch and saves three. Excellent from the skipper!
safe! Full and swinging into the pads. Narine clears his front leg and swings for the hills. Hacks it on the bounce to long on
back of a length just outside off. Rahane gets up on his toes and taps it gently towards backward point

Cummins breaks through early, and de Kock's hot and cold tournament continues! Bumper on the stumps and this seems to get a little big on de Kock. More than that, he gets cramped for room and cannot extend his arms fully. Cloths his pull and Ansari makes no mistake at deep mid wicket. de Kock is disappointed as he walks off; Cummins delighted, because his plan has come off. KKR rocked early!
back of a length, jamming into leg stump and cramping Narine for room. He has a hack at it and the ball rolls off his pads into the off side
full toss outside off. Narine backs away and drills it straight to extra cover. He will feel he missed out there
well well! Zipped into the blockhole just outside leg. Narine gets into a bit of a tangle and swishes at thin air. Gets nutmegged too. Cummins has a wry smile on his face
fetch that, says Sunil Narine! Banged into the track outside off and this sits up nicely for Narine. He picks the length up, clears his front hip and swats it over deep mid wicket!
oh! Back of a length, pitching on middle and off and then nipping away with the angle. de Kock goes nibbling at it and is beaten on the outside
back of a length on middle and off, de Kock gets behind the line and drops it into the off side with soft hands
shortish just outside off. de Kock lets the ball come to him before stabbing it into the off side
shortish, slanting into leg stump from around the wicket. Narine has a half-hearted tug at it and the ball pops up off his body into the on side. That was bowled at 140.4kph
back of a length on leg stump. de Kock gets up on his toes and stabs it into the square leg region to get off the mark
off the pads and into the fence! Back of a length, swinging into the pads. de Kock is late on the flick but the ball brushes enough of his pad to beat the keeper to his right!
wild delivery to start off. A mile outside leg and Klaasen does well to get something behind it. That swung a great deal, though

goes a mle up, and that is all over, Red Rover! The Kolkata Knight Riders have rocked up at the Eden Gardens and they have handed their fellow finalists from last year and absolute thrashing! Off-pace and into the track just outside off. Harshal has an ungainly swipe across the line and gets no distance whatsoever. Russell is the only person in the vicinity and he settles under it to consign SRH to a fate that seemed in the making for the past hour. A proper pasting, and SRH will have plenty to dissect and gulp down from this!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Harshal jams down on it and clinks it back towards the bowler. Right off the toe-end that
back of a length on middle and off. Shami waits for it and turns it towards deep mid wicket
safe! SRH live to tell another tale! Full outside off. Harshal throws his hands at it but slices it too much. Skews it up and it just evades backward point running back
slower yorker that goes wrong and strays down leg. Harshal fails to lay bat on ball and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length outside off. Harshal drops it into the off side and calls Shami through for an easy single
back of a length on middle and off. Shami goes back and works it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length delivery that slides down leg. Shami does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
on a length wide outside off. Shami reaches out for it and pokes it towards backward point
googly tossed up full outside off. Shami gets his front pad outside the line and then gets rapped on it, playing well outside the line of the ball

hot knife through butter, and that is an absolute peach! Fizzed through on a length just outside off. Simarjeet goes searching for it but has no clue this is the ball that will spin into him. Leaves a massive gap between bat and pad, and the ball bursts through the gate to smash into the stumps. Chakravarthy has three, KKR have nine, and SRH on the brink!

clothed to long on, and after a brief pause, the procession is back on track! Given a bit of air on a length just outside off. That entices Cummins into the slog but he is not close enough to the pitch of the ball. Miscues it terribly and Rana, stationed well inside the long on fence, snares the chance with minimal fuss. SRH eight down, and staring down the barrel!

a superb direct hit, but Harshal might have made his ground! Back of a length on off. Cummins dabs it towards backward point and calls his partner through. Harshal stretches and that might have saved him, despite Rana producing a moment of fielding brilliance. The umpire, in fact, is happy with it and reaches that conclusion without even going upstairs!
low full toss on leg stump. Harshal tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket

miscued and taken at square leg! Arora proves his worth yet again, and that might be that for SRH tonight! Slower bumper outside off, asking Klaasen to fetch it to the leg side. He takes up the challenge but comes up second-best. No timing at all and the ball spoons up for Moeen, stood right on the ring. SRH's hopes dashed further, and KKR can sense a win now!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Cummins reaches out for it and flat-bats it towards long on
full and wide this time. Klaasen throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep backward point
almost a chop-on, and Klaasen gets four for his toil! Into the blockhole outside off. Klaasen looks to shovel it away and gets an inside edge that flashes past the stumps and the keeper!
back of a length on the stumps. Klaasen eases it down the ground to long on
back of a length outside off. Cummins winds up and heaves it towards long on
dragged down on leg stump. Spins back into Klaasen and keeps low, which is why that ball escaped his wrath. Off the back leg towards short fine leg

has he nicked that?! de Kock thinks so, but no one else is interested! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Klaasen has a swish at it and seems to miss it. de Kock threw the ball up in celebration, but got no support from his teammates. Oh wow - UltraEdge confirms there was bat involved. Missed opportunity for KKR!
this is much bigger and much better! Very similar to the last ball, perhaps a little outside off. That gives Klaasen more swinging room and he clatters it over cow corner!
Klaasen goes bang! Marginally short on middle and leg. Klaasen picks the length early, gets his front hip out of the way and smears it over deep mid wicket!
off-pace on a full length on middle and off. Klaasen flicks it to long on and keeps strike
slower ball on a length on leg stump. Cummins is too early into the stroke and edges it down to deep third
streaky but that is still four! Another bumper, on middle and off. Cummins swings his blade like an axe and the ball hurtles off the top edge over the keeper's head!

ooff! Another short ball on middle stump. Cummins takes his eyes off it and gets lucky as the ball whistles past his bat, his ear and his helmet. Cummins having a chat to the umpire because Rana's towel fell off as he delivered the ball
dug into the track on leg stump. Cummins hops up onto his toes and fends it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Klaasen rides the bounce and taps it into the off side
back of a length on off. Klaasen waits for it and knocks it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Cummins pokes it towards the bowler, who makes a half-hearted attempt to stop it. Parries it towards mid wicket and Cummins gets a run
back of a length outside off. Skids off the surface and Cummins, looking to dab behind point, is beaten for pace
tossed up full just outside off. Drifts in before gripping in the surface and straightening. Cummins wafts at it and is beaten all ends up
back of a length, pitching on off and nipping back in. Cummins is cut in half and the ball grazes his back thigh before rolling away past short third
back of a length outside off. Cummins goes back and taps it towards extra cover
full and wide outside off. Cummins gets forward and drives it towards sweeper cover
oh, hello! Floated up full on middle and off. Cummins walks across his stumps early and then laps it past the keeper for four. Well well!

Aniket falls trying to increase the scoring rate, and this is looking like KKR's evening now! Angled in on a length on middle and leg. Aniket has a mow across the line and shanks it completely. Off the inside half of the bat and Venkatesh, despite losing it in the lights for a bit, makes no mistake at deep mid wicket. Rahane gambled with Chakravarthy's third over, and that gamble has paid off!
darted across on a length wide outside off. Left alone by the batter and called a wide
short outside off. Spins away and Klaasen reads that, cutting it towards deep point
shortish on leg stump. Aniket opens up his stance and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Skids onto the batter and Aniket hurriedly stabs it into the off side
back of a length on the stumps. Aniket goes back and eases it out to deep point
back of a length, sliding down leg. Aniket does not get bat on it and the umpire calls it a wide
off the mark in sumptuous style! A touch short outside off and Aniket is all over it like a rash. Rocks back, opens his bat face and steers it beautifully between backward point and deep point!
fullish on middle and leg. Aniket stretches forward and defends

caught comfortably on the fence, and another SRH batter perishes! On the shorter side outside off and this grips in the surface, spinning away. Seems to stick in the surface too and Kamindu can generate no power on the pull. Simple catch to deep mid wicket, and SRH take another step back after threatening to take a step forward!
shortish outside off and this spins away a great deal, making Kamindu reach out. He flat-bats it past the bowler and gets two for his troubles
shortish on the stumps. Klaasen opens up his stance and hacks it to long on
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Seems like a top-spinner because this bounces extra and goes over Kamindu's flailing blade
on a fullish length just outside off. Kamindu presses half forward and pats it towards backward point
back of a length on the stumps. Klaasen hangs back and pushes it to long on
deftly done! Shortish on leg stump. Klaasen gauges the line early, gets inside it and then helps it fine to the fence!
slanted in full on middle and off. Kamindu brings out the reverse and smashes it on the bounce to deep point. He got plenty of purchase on that
back of a length on middle and leg. Keeps a little low and Klaasen adjusts to poke it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Klaasen reads it off the pitch and knocks it to long on
back of a length just outside off. Kamindu hangs back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. That kept a little low
length ball on leg stump. Klaasen waits for it and works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on middle and leg. Tucked up for room, Klaasen stabs it to mid wicket
on a length just outside off. Nips away a touch and that extracts the leading edge as Kamindu looks to work to leg. Dribbles away towards sweeper cover
fired in full on middle and off. Klaasen comes forward and eases it to long on
another six on the pull for Kamindu Mendis! Banged in again and outside leg again, which means it is right into Kamindu's arc. He swivels inside the line and hoists it a mile over fine leg!
full just outside off. Klaasen's feet do not move much but he drives it back past the bowler for a single

oh, what have you done, Nitish Kumar Reddy?! Slanted in on a length on middle and off. Reddy plants his front foot and almost half-heartedly, flicks it in the air. Picks out Narine to absolute perfection, almost like catching practice, and Reddy cannot believe what he has done. He did not keep that down, nor did he show enough conviction to go over that sweeper. Strange and soft dismissal, and SRH lurch further into crisis!
back of a length on middle and off. Kamindu presses half forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket
this is another sizzler! Fuller outside off. Kamindu picks the length early, gets onto the front foot and cracks it over extra cover!
do not bowl there to Kamindu Mendis! Shortish on the hips and Kamindu thrives playing that stroke. Perfect pick-up pull and it flies high and long over deep backward square leg!
flighted up full just outside off, from around the wicket. Driven down the ground to long on
back of a length on the stumps. Reddy goes back and punches it towards long on
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Reddy stays back and prods it towards mid wicket

falls across badly, and gets rapped on the pads. Not given, though! Tossed up beautifully and this starts outside off before drifting back in devilishly. Reddy's balance is all over the place and he misses his flick. Gets struck on the pad and even though that seemed to be heading down leg, KKR have reviewed. No bat involved, clearly, and Ball Tracking has the ball missing leg stump by a fair margin. KKR burn a review, and Reddy stays!
pushed in on a length on off. Reddy presses half forward and pokes it towards mid wicket
back of a length on leg stump. Reddy tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg. Calls for two and scampers back to complete it
back of a length, honing into off stump. Reddy dabs it into the backward point region and keeps strike
back of a length outside off. Nips back in a little and Reddy, trying to swipe across the line, is beaten by the inward movement
14 off the over already! Reddy is counter-punching! Loose again, a low full toss on the pads. Reddy snaps his wrists into action and shovels it over the deep backward square leg fence!
dispatched! That made such a nice sound off the bat! Half-tracker outside off that sits up for Reddy. He stands up on his toes and belts it in front of square!
low full toss, slanting into the pads. Reddy gets squared up a touch and plonks it towards the bowler
Reddy with his first boundary! First real loose ball Arora has bowled tonight. On a length and also down leg. Reddy gets under it and helps it over short fine leg!
safe! Shortish on leg stump. Rushes onto Kamindu and gets a little big on him. He splices his pull but it lands into space in the deep mid wicket region
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Kamindu waits for it and dabs it towards short third, who dives to his left and parries it towards deep backward point. Off the mark with a brace
banged into the track outside off. Kamindu has a swipe at it but cannot fight the angle or the pace Rana is generating. Flashes past his blade
off-pace on a length just outside off. Reddy comes forward and bunts it towards mid on to get off the mark
dug into the track outside off. Reddy looks to punch it through cover while being up on his toes but scuffs it badly. Bobbles back to the bowler
back of a length outside off. Reddy watches it go through to the keeper

chipped straight to Russell, but he puts it down! Full on middle and off. Kamindu tries to over mid on and ends up popping it towards Russell. He seems to mistime his jump ad that means the ball slips out of his grasp. Russell cannot believe it. KKR cannot either!
full on leg stump. Kamindu looks to flick it away but does not lay bat on ball again. Thuds into his pads. Might have pitched outside leg, hence the lack of an lbw appeal
peach! Full in the channel and this seems to swerve away late. By then, Kamindu is committed to playing it towards mid on and gets beaten all ends up
back of a length outside off. Kamindu looks to dab it away but ends up chopping it off the under-edge towards the keeper
full and slanted across the batter outside off. Kamindu goes chasing after it and sees the ball whiz past his flailing blade

oh my days - stop the press and play that on loop and repeat all night long! Full outside off and Kishan's eyes light up. He looks to carve it through extra cover and absolutely smashes it. Rahane, though, is sharper. Much sharper, in fact. He takes a step to his left, snaps down and then grabs hold of it with both hands. Two in two for KKR, three in three overs, and SRH are in danger of flat-lining prematurely!

Abhishek bites the dust too, and SRH's chase is spiraling early! Another off-pace ball, on a length outside off. Abhishek advances and tries to smash it into oblivion. Plays too early and only manages a thick outside edge that floats through to slip. The easiest of catches and Travishek have been sent packing inside two overs!
slower ball on a full length outside off. Abhishek thinks about swinging at it before opting to leave it alone. Asks his partner whether it is worth a review but Kishan says no
back of a length outside off. Kishan waits for this and opens his bat face to guide it towards deep backward point
back of a length in the channel just outside off. Kisses the surface and zips through, whistling past the shoulder of the bat
slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Kishan swishes at it wildly and misses. Called a wide, though

dug into the track just outside leg. Abhishek advances, tries to force it through the off side and shanks it off the inside edge into his body. The ball bobbles to the right of the pitch, allowing Kishan to pinch a run
back of a length on off. Abhishek stays leg side and pokes it towards cover point. Not a great deal of foot movement there
hard length just outside off. Abhishek rises with the bounce and punches it towards deep backward point
back of a length just outside off. Abhishek hangs back and jabs it towards cover
length in the channel. Kishan comes forward and pushes it into the point region to get off the mark
length ball angled across the batter just outside off. Kishan gets a good stride in and lets it go

goes a mile up and Rana takes a superb catch tumbling back! Head falls early, and Arora gets him for the second time in as many games! Full and swinging away outside off. Head looks to go over mid off but does not get enough on it. Gets more height than distance and Rana, back-pedaling, keeps his eyes on the ball the entire way. Clings onto the chance, and that is a massive moment early in the game!

off the mark straightaway! Fullish just outside off and this is not the most controlled of strokes. Head goes through with the drive and chips it enough to Rana's left at mid off. Gathers pace as it hits the outfield and then hits the cushion too!
